item.title: A Moment in Time – Marcus Hayes
9.14.23 Troubles are an opportunity to grow!
item.description: Dear brothers and sisters, when troubles of any kind come your way, consider it an opportunity for great joy. For you know that when your faith is tested, your endurance has a chance to grow. So let it grow, for when your endurance is fully developed, you will be perfect and complete, needing nothing.

item.title: 9.15.23 God’s Spirit gives us power, love, and soundness of mind!
item.description: For God has not given us a spirit of fear and timidity, but of power, love, and self-discipline.
